paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa a-inn a om a, TOUPA'N akimvel a melmate tengteng a pan galmuang a a-omsak nung in;
heading: David Kiang A Nathan Thugen / (1 Kro 17.1-15)
english: When the king lived in his house, and Yahweh had given him rest from all his enemies all around,

paite: Kumpipa'n zawlnei Nathan kiang ah, "Tu in en in kei sidar sing inn ah ka teng a, himahleh Pathian bawm puanin ah a-om,” achi hi.
english: the king said to Nathan the prophet, “See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but God’s ark dwells within curtains.”

paite: Nathan in kumpipa kiang ah, "Na lungsim a om bangtak in va hih in, na kiang ah TOUPA a-om hi," achi hi.
english: Nathan said to the king, “Go, do all that is in your heart, for Yahweh is with you.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai zan mah in Nathan kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: That same night, Yahweh’s word came to Nathan, saying,

paite: "Ka sikha David va hilh in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Ka tenna ding inn na hon lamsak ding maw?' "
english: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh says, “Should you build me a house for me to dwell in?

paite: Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak a pan tuni tan in inn ah ka teng kei a, puanin ah leh biakbuk ah ka teng zaw hi.
english: For I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought the children of Israel up out of Egypt, even to this day, but have moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle.

paite: Israel suante lak a ka paina tengteng ah leng, ka mi Israel vak dia thu ka piak vaihawmte kiang ah, "Bangziak a sidar sing a inn hon lamsak lou?" chi in ka gen ngei a hia?
english: In all places in which I have walked with all the children of Israel, did I say a word to anyone from the tribes of Israel whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people Israel, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

paite: Huaiziak in ka sikha David kiang ah, sepaihte! TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Belam tatna mun a pan belam na ven lai in ka mi Israel mite tung a heutu ding in ka hon la hi.
english: Now therefore tell my servant David this: ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people, over Israel.

paite: Na hohna peuh ah na kiang ah ka om zel a, na ma ah na melmate ka hihmang zel hi. Lei a mithupitakte bang in min thupitak ka hon bawlsak hi.
english: I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a great name, like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

paite: Hiai ban ah ka mi Israelte a ding in mun ka sep dia, amau ka suan ding a, amau mun mah ah ateng ding ua, tuma lam bang in gitlouhna tate'n ahihbuai nawn kei ding uh.
english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not afflict them any more, as at the first,

paite: Na melmate tengteng lak a pan ka hon khawlsak hi. Huai lou him in TOUPA'N inn ka hon bawlsak ding, chi in ahon hilh hi.
english: and as from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will cause you to rest from all your enemies. Moreover Yahweh tells you that Yahweh will make you a house.

paite: Na ni abei a na pute kiang a na lup chiang in, na nung a na suan na gil a gah ding ka tungding ding a, agam ka hihkip ding.
english: When your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will set up your offspring after you, who will proceed out of your body, and I will establish his kingdom.

paite: Ama'n ka min a ding in inn alam dia, agam laltutphah tangtawn a ding in ka hihkip ding.
english: He will build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

paite: Apa ka hi ding a, amah ka tapa ahi ding. Thil ahihkhelhleh, mihing chiang leh mihing tapate khetna in ka thunun ding.
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men and with the stripes of the children of men;

paite: Himahleh, na ma a ka suanmang Saul kiang a pan ka lakmang bang in ka zahngaihna in ahon paisan kei ding hi.
english: but my loving kindness will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.

paite: Na inkuan leh na gam tangtawn a hihkip ngiungeu ahi dia, na laltutphah lah tangtawn in hihkip ahi ding," chi in.
english: Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you. Your throne will be established forever.”’”

paite: Huai thute tengteng bang zel leh huai kilakna bang geih in Nathan in David kiang ah agen hi.
english: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa David alut a, TOUPA ma ah atu hi, "Toupa PATHIAN aw, kua ahia ka hih a, ka inkuante bang ahia ahih uh, hiai tantan na hon pi?
heading: David Kipahthugen Thumna / (1 Kro 17.16-27)
english: Then David the king went in and sat before Yahweh; and he said, “Who am I, Lord Yahweh, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

paite: Toupa PATHIAN aw, huaite leng nang mitmuh in thil bangmah tham ahi kei uh. Himahleh na sikha inkuan omdan ding thu kum tampi sung a ding in leng na gen khinta hi. Toupa PATHIAN aw, hiaite mihing hihdan ahi a hia?
english: This was yet a small thing in your eyes, Lord Yahweh, but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come; and this among men, Lord Yahweh!

paite: David in na kiang ah bang agen nawn tuan dia? Toupa PATHIAN aw, na sikha lah na thei vek ngal a.
english: What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Lord Yahweh.

paite: Na sikha theih ding in na thu ziak leh nangmah lungtang bang zel in hiai thil thupi tengteng na hihta hi.
english: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA Pathian aw, nang na thupi hi. Ka bil ua ka zak bang un nang bang kuamah a-om kei a, nangmah lou ngal Pathian a-om kei hi,
english: Therefore you are great, Yahweh God. For there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan leh namte leh apathiante ua pan tankhia a, min bawlsak ding leh na gam a dia na mite ma a thil thupitak leh thil lauhuaitak hih ding na mi Israelte bang leitung ah namdang kua a-om a?
english: What one nation on the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make himself a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

paite: Huchi in Israel mite tangtawn a na mite ahong hihtheihna ding un nang a ding in na hihkipta hi. TOUPA, nang a Pathian uh na hong hita hi.
english: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.

paite: "Huchi in TOUPA Pathian aw, na sikha tungtang thu leh a-inkuante tungtang thu na gen tangtawn a ding in hihkip inla, na gensa bang in hih in.
english: “Now, Yahweh God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever, and do as you have spoken.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA Israelte' Pathian ahi, chi in na min tangtawn in pahtawi in om hen. Huchi in na sikha David inkuante na ma ah hihkip in a-om ding uhi.
english: Let your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies is God over Israel; and the house of your servant David will be established before you.’

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA aw, Israel Pathian, na sikha kiang ah, inkuan ka hon phuhsak ding, chi in lah na puangta ngal a. Huaiziak in na sikha in hiai thumna na kiang ka hon tun ngam hi.
english: For you, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.

paite: "Tu in Toupa PATHIAN aw, nang huai Pathian na hi a, na thu dik hen, hiai thil hoih na sikha kiang ah na chiamta hi.
english: “Now, O Lord Yahweh, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in na sikha inkuante na ma a tangtawn a a-om gige theihna ding un vualzawl in. Toupa PATHIAN aw, nang lah na genta ngal a. Na vualzawlna in na sikha inkuante tangtawn in vualzawl in om uhen," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Lord Yahweh, have spoken it. Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing.”
